outcome: Abnormalities in umbilical cord and amniotic fluid
Prolonged hospital stay (both mothers and infants)
cohort: 5,412 cycles from 4,908 women who achieved singleton livebirths following elective single cryopreserved-thawed blastocyst transfer
finding: The non-assisted hatching TE biopsy does not increase the risks of most adverse perinatal outcomes, but there is a higher GDM incidence in the biopsy group, warranting further study.
